name: Corrosion / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A dissolving limb pulls apart with a short viscous wet rip, a dense acidic spit and a brief sizzling etch at the stump. Fast tear onset, shorter than a sustained acid death.
